title: The Office of Civic Time
subtitle: Organization · Formal institution · registry and public utility

fields.label: Aspects
fields.value: Every Borrowed Hour Must Be Accounted For; The Seal Outranks the Person Holding It.

fields.label: Mandate / structure
fields.value: Registers voluntary time loans and runs the hospital reserve. Collectors deliver warrants; auditors certify consent; a commissioner authorizes collection.

fields.label: Resources / weakness
fields.value: Controls the bell tower, official seals and maintenance crews. Lawful collection requires two separately timestamped witnesses to certify a completed roll with every debtor named. Adding or changing a debtor requires fresh certification by both witnesses; the altered roll was never recertified.

fields.label: Faces / disagreement
fields.value: Vale controls policy. Nera knows field practice. Night auditor Ansel wants a defensible audit, not a revolution, and can issue a temporary stay.

fields.label: Access routes
fields.value: A valid petition, a public hearing, a staff ally or a covert service entrance can reach the same records with different risks.

fields.label: GM use
fields.value: Run the Office as people and procedures, not a single evil mind. A lawful stay can halt collection while preserving hospital supply. No faction-scale subsystem is assumed.
